MagSafe on the entry-level iPhone just made 256GB the new floor — and every accessory brand still sleeping on MagSafe ecosystem plays just lost their last excuse.

The budget tier doesn't exist anymore. Founders, act accordingly.

What's your MagSafe angle?
source_story_title: iPhone 17E Officially Announced: A19 Chip, 256GB Base Storage, MagSafe at $599
source_story_summary: Apple has officially announced the iPhone 17E, featuring the A19 chip, the new C1X modem, a doubling of base storage to 256GB, and the long-awaited addition of MagSafe — all while holding the price at $599. This represents a significant value upgrade for Apple's entry-level 'E' (formerly SE) lineup, closing the gap with flagship offerings in terms of storage and ecosystem features.
